new_text: If the user cannot be notified of the event the first time, the WASP platform should retry to notify the user of the occurrence of the event at most three times, until the user has been notified or a specified time-out elapses.
change_description: Limit notification retries to three.

new_text: A user's profile must contain at least two charging points for a specific user.
change_description: Require two charging points instead of one.

new_text: The WASP platform should be able to provide the end-user with walking, cycling or driving instructions.
change_description: Add cycling instructions.

new_text: The WASP platform must allow the end-user to specify the notification type when setting an alert.
change_description: Make choosing the notification type mandatory (should -> must).

new_text: The WASP platform shall provide functionality to retrieve the current location of the user with an accuracy of 50 metres.
change_description: Add a location accuracy of 50 metres.

new_text: Services must have associated schedule information (this service is available weekdays from 9:00 till 17:00), a service may be available 24/7. The registry must check for their existence, it may supply a default schedule if none was specified.
change_description: Change example service hours.

new_text: A WASP application shall be able to setup a phone call or SMS connection using the 3G Platform via the WASP platform.
change_description: Add SMS connections.

new_text: The WASP platform must be able to show the location of users and their buddies on a map.
change_description: Also show buddies on the map.

new_text: The WASP platform shall provide functionality to search for other people registered in the platform by name or phone number.
change_description: Search people by name or phone number.

new_text: The WASP platform must be able to render all maps on small, mobile devices, tablets, as well as large, fixed terminals.
change_description: Add tablets to supported devices.

new_text: The WASP platform should be able to calculate a route between two or more arbitrarily chosen points.
change_description: Stop avoiding traffic jams and construction works in route calculation.

new_text: The WASP platform shall allow end-users to give and remove Create, Read, Update, Delete (CRUD) access rights on parts of the user profile to other users and specific WASP applications.
change_description: The 3G Platform no longer receives profile access rights.

new_text: The WASP platform shall be able to update status and location information of buddies in the user's buddy list based either on request of the user or after login into the WASP platform.
change_description: Remove the regular-interval buddy update.

new_text: A WASP application should be able to automatically adapt content and the presentation of functionality to the user's device.
change_description: Platform no longer offers generic adaptation services.

new_text: The WASP platform shall provide functionality to find services that match the user's explicit need and obey the restrictions following from the user's profile and current context.
change_description: Search results no longer link to service profiles.

new_text: Application data may be cached on the end-user's device for offline use, encrypted with the user's credentials.
change_description: Allow offline data on the device (reverses the old rule).

new_text: Charging is handled by an external payment provider; the WASP platform only forwards payment requests.
change_description: Move charging to an external payment provider.

new_text: The WASP platform must answer 95% of requests within 2 seconds.
change_description: Replace best-effort with a response-time guarantee.

new_text: A restaurant application must provide online food ordering with home delivery.
change_description: Replace table reservation with food delivery.

new_text: The WASP platform shall check for new events every five minutes.
change_description: Replace continuous monitoring with polling.

new_text: The WASP platform must show navigation routes in an augmented-reality camera view.
change_description: Replace map routes with an AR view.

new_text: Authentication must be delegated to the single sign-on service of the 3G platform.
change_description: Move authentication to 3G single sign-on.

new_text: There should be an application that lets mobile users share their calendars with their buddies.
change_description: Replace meeting scheduling with calendar sharing.
Delete the rule that the user must authorize charging.
Delete alerts on buddy status/location changes.
Applications can no longer send messages through the platform.
Delete traffic-jam and construction information.
Profiles no longer have expiry dates.
Restaurant application no longer learns from feedback.
Delete retrieving location from the 3G Platform.
